items.title: Industry body GJC alerts BIS over gold adulteration using Rhenium, Iridium
items.rss_summary: The All India Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) on Friday said it alerted the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) about reports of the alleged use of Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys to increase gold's weight, and urged the industry and consumers to remain vigilant. "While there have been media reports from certain quarters regarding the possible misuse of materials such as Rhenium and Iridium in gold, we want to assure the entire jewellery industry and all gold buyers that there is absolutely no reason to panic. The Bureau of Indian Standards is treating the matter with utmost seriousness," GJC Chairman Rajesh Rokde said in a statement. According to media reports, Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys were allegedly used to increase gold's weight without a corresponding increase in purity. items.title: Bitcoin nears USD 60,000: What traders should watch, according to WazirX
items.rss_summary: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 20: Bitcoin has lost roughly 21% since the October close and is trading below USD 62,000 and faces sustained US spot ETF outflows. November is often associated with strong gains for the cryptocurrency, but this year its price has moved in the opposite direction. From an October close near USD77,474, Bitcoin fell into the 62,000-64,000 range. By November 20, it was around USD 61,445, roughly one-fifth below the October close and more than 50% below its 2025 peak near USD 126,000.
